blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday served a subpoena to Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte to appear as the prosecution panel’s witness in the impeachment trial of her sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. Two members of the Senate Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms personally went to Davao City to serve the subpoena ordering Mayor Duterte to appear before the Senate from September 28 to 30 at 10 a.m. “You are hereby commanded to appear before the Senate Impeachment Court… to testify your knowledge in the case which is before the Court in which the House of Representatives has […]...
